parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100.
Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The ID information of file systems and virtual storage channels. A maximum of 10 entries can be specified per batch.

parameters.name: RoleChain
parameters.description:
The role chain.
>Required only for cross-account scenarios.
